target_customer: Owners of businesses that sell bookable time slots such as fitness studios, golf simulators, med spas, museums and tours
problem: Unsold appointment slots are perishable revenue. Booko forecasts demand per slot and sets prices between owner-chosen floor and ceiling, working inside existing booking systems.
business_model: B2B SaaS pricing engine, likely revenue-based or subscription (pricing not published)

founders.name: Will Hall
founders.background_notes: A press release headline refers to 19-year-old founders, but no age is attributed to individuals.

founders.name: Arjun Saluja
prior_employers: Joby Aviation (Uber Elevate team, dynamic pricing)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists both founders as Founder/CEO.

competitors.name: ClassPass SmartRate
competitors.what: Dynamic pricing engine and spot allocation for studios on the ClassPass marketplace
competitors.funding_then: owned by Mindbody and ClassPass parent

competitors.name: Mindbody dynamic pricing
competitors.what: Dynamic pricing built in after acquiring Lymber

competitors.name: Dibs Technology
competitors.what: Dynamic pricing for boutique fitness classes

technical_complexity.rationale: Demand forecasting per slot and per location plus integrations with booking systems like Mindbody and Mariana Tek; standard ML with integration burden.

defensibility.rationale: Pricing decisions data (46.7M reported) may compound, but booking platforms already ship dynamic pricing.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Mindbody and ClassPass already offered dynamic pricing; no action against Booko recorded.

market_need_then: Fitness and service operators face empty off-peak slots, and incumbents publish guides on dynamic pricing; Booko reports about 20 percent revenue lift for early customers (company claim) and 98 locations across 22 countries as of November 2026.

branding.domain_note: Company site is booko.com per YC page while one source calls bookoapp.com its site; Booko is also the name of an unrelated book price comparison site

identity.visual_style: Minimal dark site with a pause animations option
identity.voice_and_tone: Short and direct: Make more money from every hour you sell

branding.brand_signature: Dynamically pricing the whole economy tagline
branding.community_and_virality: A January 2026 press release described a viral dynamic pricing feature by young founders; launch covered by StartupResearcher

brand_strength.rationale: Short friendly name with some launch press, but confusable with other Booko and booking brands.

outcome_analysis: Booko is a Winter 2026 company that is active and too new for an outcome. Founders with pricing experience from Joby launched in early 2026 and report broad deployment, but incumbents already sell dynamic pricing in booking software and no funding beyond YC is confirmed.
notes: VCBacked lists $500K pre-seed in March 2026 with YC as investor and Dealroom a $125K seed; both aggregators, unverified, so no round is recorded. Press release headline mentions 19-year-old founders but no individual ages are sourced. Competitor sources are undated incumbent blog posts approximated to 2025.
